direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh at 1366x768, overflow hidden; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; independent reserved zones for scene, callouts, stations and jobs; rendered scene at least 70% of main; side content condensed within its zone; targets at least 36px, equal-width non-wrapping rail items with aria-current and arrow-key movement
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22), silver #C5CCD4, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68), emerald #A8F04A with #050705 text and one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, x marker and plain OFFLINE text; official logo immutable in black, emerald and brushed silver at native aspect in header and opening story only
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px; header tabs spanning most of header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step
direction.motion: Living material flow, state glow, depth and cinematic transitions driven by real state; 160-220ms ease-out selection, one 240ms route trace on state change; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, x marker and OFFLINE text retain meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; compact horizontal rail only; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene; connection readiness checks for provider identity kept separate from investigation evidence task under distinct headings, status and controls; action bar with Back left, status centre, one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens one-click Approve then Authorize this decision wall; pending task proposals untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and approved recovery plan may coexist while replacements await approval; skip-to-stage, Enter/Space activation, Esc close, aria-live polite results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG filling at least 70% of main: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes emerald only, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with x marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text
